Clause-②: yes (widening) — new `@object-ui/i18n` keys (`designMode.menu.*` for the new picker row and name step, `dashboard.noCards.*`), in all 11 locales; no spec, schema or public export change
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPiTdmLxHXBjakSvJy

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在设计模式里「添加菜单项 → 仪表盘」，第一行是「新建仪表盘…」，填名称确定后，新仪表盘出现在占好的菜单位置，其他改动一起保存，然后直接进入它的编辑状态；没有卡片的仪表盘会显示「还没有卡片」。
- 为什么做：设计模式专题的第三张卡，让管理员不用进 Studio 就能在应用里新建仪表盘并挂到菜单上。
- 出错会怎样：菜单保存失败时，刚建的仪表盘会被删掉，设计模式保持打开并说明原因；中途取消什么都不写；可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：不用做什么。新建报表这一半席位已定（报表必须先选数据集和指标，改为从报表搭建页新建），等 #36374 合并后另做。

## What changes

- The design-mode picker's Dashboards list starts with 「New dashboard…」 (`DesignModeMenu.tsx`). It asks for a name only. 「Cancel」 (or closing the dialog) writes nothing and drops the held place.
- 「Create」 runs, in order (`designModeMenuCreate.ts`): every check of the menu save first (`prepareAppMenuSave`, split out of `saveAppMenu` unchanged in behaviour); the dashboard created empty (`{ name, label, widgets: [] }`) and published in the menu's own package (the app's package when listed writable, else its `.custom` pair via the ensure door; ADR-0146 D2, #35624 ruling C) through the existing confirmed-save door `saveDashboardInPlace`; then the menu written and published with the new entry in the held place and every other staged menu edit (`writeAppMenu`). Where the menu cannot be saved, nothing is created: no package-less fallback.
- A refused menu removes the dashboard again (the item DELETE with `?package=`, measured on a live server: `Deleted dashboard ... it no longer exists`). If that removal is refused too, the error says the dashboard was left.
- The design mode gains `saveWith(key, change)` (`designMode.tsx`): commit everything staged with one change in its key's place, never staging it on its own, so a failed create leaves no half-written entry staged for a later Save.
- The machine name is generated from the name (Chinese through pinyin), and checked free on the server (`GET /meta/dashboard/:name`) so a create never publishes over an existing dashboard.
- On success the mode is left and the page navigates to the dashboard with a one-time navigation-state landing (`designModeArrival.ts`); `DashboardView.tsx` opens its #36372 edit state on that landing once the Edit button is offered, and clears it.
- A dashboard with no cards now draws 「No cards yet」 instead of a blank canvas (view mode only).
- **Not in this PR: 「New report…」.** The spec refuses a report without `dataset` + `values`, and the server's draft save refuses it too (`INVALID_METADATA`, measured), so a name-only report cannot be created. The seat's premise correction on the card (comment 7090058961) settles it: 「New report…」 opens the report builder (#36374) in a create mode and writes the report and its menu entry once a dataset and a measure are picked; that half follows after #36374 merges.

Branch name: this card thread's container pushes only to `claude/project-thread-un7cwb`, so the `claude/issue-36364-*` spelling the Duplicate Fix Guard looks for is not available; the card is #36364 (claim comment 7088329990).

Overlap: touches `DashboardView.tsx`, which draft PR #36461 also touches; `overlap-check` reads both merging cleanly. This PR lands after #36461 per the claim.

## Tests

<details><summary>Unit and component tests (head 313b6bf8)</summary>

Run from the repo root under `os-verify-lock`; vitest root `ui/`.

- Head `313b6bf8` merges `origin/main`, bringing #36604 (the `designModeMenu.ts` rename to `designModeMenuModel.ts`), #36622 (#36591's menu `order` rule) and #36461. The one conflict, in `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`, was resolved by keeping both sides: this card's `server` mock, its reset and its describe, next to #36591's `servedNav` and its describe. Two imports were moved to the renamed module (`designModeMenuCreate.ts` and its test); no file names the old module any more. #36591's `inShownOrder` / `withOrderRewritten` auto-merged into `prepareAppMenuSave`, so the create path applies the same rule. It is pinned by a new test: the new entry, held between two entries of an `order`-carrying level, is saved as `[customer 0, nav_item_1 1, contact 2, opportunity 3]`.
- At `313b6bf8`, after rebuilding the app-shell dependency closure (`VERDICT command-exit 0`): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/i18n/` plus the 9 `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView*.test.tsx` files gives `Test Files 271 passed (271)`, `Tests 3301 passed | 13 skipped (3314)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This covers the 4 card files and every layout/i18n/DashboardView test the merge touched.
- At `313b6bf8`: `designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts` alone gives `Tests 14 passed (14)`.
- At `313b6bf8`: `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`) gives `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 0 `error TS`.
- Earlier, at `ab2257f4`: the i18n run plus the 4 card files gave 110 files and 2050 tests passing. At `0647077c`, a narrowed app-shell + i18n run found 3 failures caused by this change: zh-Hant was not regenerated, and the de quote count was 125 against 126. Both were fixed. The full app-shell suite is left to CI's `Test` shards.
- New and extended pins:
  - `designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts`: 14 tests (13, plus the `order` pin).
  - `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`: 4 tests (the create row, Cancel writes nothing, the create-and-land flow, a refused menu).
  - `designMode-36362.test.tsx`: 3 tests for `saveWith`.
  - `DashboardView.inPageEdit-36372.test.tsx`: 3 landing tests and 2 empty-state tests.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

- Removal of the created dashboard on a refused menu deleted (`ablation-replace`, anchor 1 to 0, restored blob equals HEAD): 3 tests red (`a refused menu removes the dashboard it was made for…`, `…cannot be removed says the dashboard was left`, `a refused menu removes the new dashboard; the mode, the held place and the other staged edits stay`).
- The dashboard created before the menu-save checks: 8 of 13 red in `designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts`, every "nothing is created" case among them. A first attempt of this leg was refused by the tool (the replacement contained its own anchor) and ran no tests; the second attempt is the reading above.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's first acceptance line names the group 「数据洞察」; the CRM example's group is 「数据分析」, used for the screenshots.
- 「Members see an empty state」 was checked as the admin in view mode; the empty-state branch has no role gate. A non-admin session was NOT MEASURED.
- Test pins went into the existing harness files for the design mode, the menu editor and the dashboard in-page edit (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness goes into that file), plus one new file for the new module, `designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts`.

## Verification

Screenshots (live CRM example on a `--fresh` backend, console dev server, zh-CN, deviceScaleFactor 2) are stored with the seat (`objectstack-seat2/36364-shots/`): design mode; picker 「仪表盘」 with 「新建仪表盘…」 first; the name step; the new 「回款分析」 in its edit state, in the held place under 数据分析; Cancel leaving nothing; the new dashboard in view mode (「还没有卡片」); Studio 「界面」 listing the same 回款分析 in the app's navigation. After the run: the dashboard is the only item of `com.example.crm.custom`, the app's stored menu holds `nav_item_1: hui_kuan_fenxi` under `group_analytics`, no draft is pending, and the cancelled name has no item (404).

Read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuCreate.ts` (the order and the removal), `designMode.tsx` (`saveWith`'s drop rule after a commit), `DashboardView.tsx` (the landing effect).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts` shows 14 passing.

<details><summary>Derived gates (head ab2257f4)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 41 commands from the tree at commit ab2257f4. Each was run with stdin from /dev/null, and its exit code was captured before any pipe. The two heavy commands ran under `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and `pnpm check:type-check-debt`.
- All 41 exited 0. The reconciliation with `--ran` reads: `Run reconciliation — 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.`
- The record is stored with the seat (`objectstack-seat2/36364-gates-ran.txt`).
- Before the PR was opened, `overlap-check` gave `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main and the open PR heads.
- At `313b6bf8`, `dispatch-gates --commands` derives the same 41 commands as at `ab2257f4`. The merge brought no new gate family for the touched paths, so the run above was not repeated. At push, `overlap-check` against origin/main is clean; it conflicts with open PR #36629 on the serial de quote-count pin, and whichever lands second rebumps it.
- CI families (lint farm, `Test` shards, `Test Core`) are left to this PR's check-runs; none was rerun locally.

</details>
